column1: # Verb stem-class flags (lemma<TAB>flags). TORE-authored from standard
# Mongolian orthography; native review pending (see tests/evaluation/spell-v1/gold/verb-gold-draft-v1.json (VERB_GOLD_DRAFT_V1, PENDING_NATIVE_REVIEW)).
#   vstem   the stem keeps its vowel before consonant-initial suffixes:
#           ажиллах → ажилла-сан (not ажилл-сан). The class cannot be read off the
#           spelling (танилцах → танилц-сан), so it is lexicon data.
#   soft-i  ь-stem verbs (барих, хорих, ярих): барьсан but баривал, барилгүй.
#   hv:<v>  hidden-vowel root whose vowel the default rule cannot predict:
#   cvb:ж / cvb:ч  lexical bare converb after a sonorant (явж, хэлж; авч, өгч).
#           Not predictable from spelling; unflagged lemmas stay UNKNOWN.
# Verbs not listed here use the default class (see morphology/analyzer.ts).
